## Flagship: Did the NIH Data Management & Sharing Policy change data sharing?

### Question
After the NIH Data Management and Sharing (DMS) Policy took effect in 2023, did more NIH-funded papers include data availability statements?

### Data
PubMed Central (PMC) open access papers linked to NIH projects, before and after the policy. [Record counts]{.todo}

### Method
Interrupted time series:

$$Y_t = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \cdot \text{time} + \beta_2 \cdot \text{policy} + \beta_3 \cdot \text{time after policy} + \varepsilon_t$$

- $\beta_2$ = immediate change in level at the policy date
- $\beta_3$ = change in slope after the policy date
